about.title: About Host Pilot
about.subtitle: Dedicated to providing safe, comfortable, and academically supportive accommodation for students.
about.vision_desc: Host Pilot was built to eliminate hostel mismanagement, seat allocation disputes, and obscure fee calculations through digital transparency, fairness, and accountability.
about.team_desc: Meet our administration staff and wardens dedicated to student welfare and security.
about.rule_1: Gate Closure: The main hostel gates close strictly at 9:30 PM every night.
about.rule_2: Quiet Hours: Study and quiet hours are maintained from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
about.rule_3: Visitor Policy: Outside guests are permitted only in the designated visitor lounge during visiting hours.
about.rule_4: Cleanliness: Students are expected to keep their rooms and common areas clean.

facilities.meal_schedule_desc: Hygeinic 3-time meal plans tailored to provide balanced nutrition.

admission.title: Online Admission Application
admission.subtitle: Submit your seat application directly online. No prior account registration is required.
admission.guideline_1: Fill out all required applicant and guardian details accurately.
admission.guideline_2: Once submitted, the administration team reviews the application.
admission.guideline_3: Upon approval, your Student ID and login credentials will be issued.
admission.disclaimer: Notice: This form operates in UI prototype mode with simulated client validation. Real data persistence will be enabled in Phase 7.
admission.success_msg: Your application has been received and assigned reference number:
